copies.bin/keep-assets.mjs: devkit-keep-assets checks each carried file's sha-256 with node:crypto inside the deploy job, which installs no shared package; devkit depends on none, so it cannot import site-runtime's encoding
copies.bin/migrations.mjs: devkit-migrations hashes migration files with node:crypto; devkit depends on no shared package, so it cannot import site-runtime's encoding
copies.bin/shared/copies.mjs: the fingerprints the check looks for are written here
copies.bin/shared/features.mjs: the feature rules name the shared pieces they look for
copies.testing/access.mjs: the Access test fake signs its own tokens; devkit depends on no shared package, so it cannot import site-runtime's encoding
copies.testing/github.mjs: the GitHub fake writes real git blob shas in hex; devkit depends on no shared package, so it cannot import site-runtime's encoding

waive.workflow:bump-consumers: a personal account has no shared Actions secret, so the ping would need its own token copy here; Renovate finds devkit's tags on its regular runs
